title: ProFL: Performative Robust Optimal Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2410.18075v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Performative prediction is a framework that captures distribution shifts that occur during the training of machine learning models due to their deployment. As the trained model is used, the induced data distribution evolves, leading to deviations from the original data distribution. The impact of such model-induced distribution shifts in federated learning (FL) is increasingly likely to transpire in real-life use cases. A recently proposed approach extends performative prediction to FL with the resulting model converging to a performative stable point, which may be far from the performative optimal point. Earlier research in centralized settings has shown that the performative optimal point can be achieved under model-induced distribution shifts, but these approaches require the performative risk to be convex and the training data to be noiseless. translated_title: ProFL：策略性鲁棒最优联邦学习
translated_abstract: 策略性预测是一种刻画机器学习模型在部署过程中因其使用而引发数据分布漂移的框架。随着训练好的模型被使用，所诱导的数据分布会不断演变，从而导致数据偏离原始分布。这种由模型诱导的分布漂移在联邦学习（FL）中的影响在现实应用场景中越来越可能出现。最近提出的一种方法将策略性预测扩展到了联邦学习，但所得到的模型收敛到的是策略性稳定点，该点可能距离策略性最优点很远。早期在集中式场景下的研究表明，在模型诱导的分布漂移下可以实现策略性最优点，但这些方法要求策略性风险是凸的，且训练数据是无噪声的。这些假设在现实的联邦学习系统中往往不成立。本文针对这些问题……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ProFL，一种在模型诱导分布漂移下无需凸性策略性风险和无噪声数据假设、可使联邦学习模型收敛到策略性最优点而非仅仅稳定点的鲁棒方法。
en_tdlr: ProFL proposes a robust federated learning approach that converges to the performative optimal point under model-induced distribution shifts without requiring a convex performative risk or noiseless training data.
